title: Sudan Atlas: official names, P-codes and boundaries for Sudan's states and localities
description:
An open toolkit that matches Sudanese place names written in Arabic or English, in any spelling, to official P-codes, and gives the names and boundaries of Sudan's 18 states, the Abyei PCA area and 189 localities.

It includes Python and JavaScript packages with identical results (PyPI and npm: sudan-atlas), a website with a map and a map-maker (https://atlas-sudan.vercel.app), and a hand-checked evaluation of the matcher. Boundaries follow OCHA's Common Operational Dataset for Sudan (COD-AB v03) and do not imply any opinion on the legal status of any territory.
notes: Code: MIT. Boundaries: CC BY 3.0 IGO, derived from OCHA COD-AB Sudan v03. Sudan Atlas's own data (spellings, matching rules, test cases): CC BY 4.0. OpenStreetMap spellings: ODbL 1.0. See LICENSE-DATA and docs/SOURCES.md.
